value.reply: Ticket [title] indicates an operational disruption in Outlook & Email with business impact, but lacks specific details: nature of disruption (e.g., send/receive failures, login errors, error messages), affected user count, and time of first occurrence. Business impact quantification (e.g., criticality, number of users affected) is also missing. These specifics are required to validate impact and coordinate remediation. Please provide exact symptoms, error messages, and scope of impact. [JIRA-19529]
